## [1.7.0-dev.4](https://github.com/d0nj/morphe-patches/compare/v1.7.0-dev.3...v1.7.0-dev.4) (2026-11-04)

### ✨ New Features

* add MET Norway as a Niagara weather provider ([f146c00](https://github.com/d0nj/morphe-patches/commit/f146c009dcb82bebcb37e8111cdb991c6818146b))

patches.name: Custom weather provider
patches.description: Serves the at-a-glance weather tile without a Niagara account, using Open-Meteo, MET Norway or Breezy Weather. Breezy Weather needs version 6.1.0 or newer with at least one location, and Niagara must be granted the "Read Breezy Weather data" permission from Niagara's app info → Permissions screen.

options.description: Source for the at-a-glance tile's forecast. Open-Meteo and MET Norway work out of the box. Breezy Weather reads your installed Breezy Weather app (6.1.0+, at least one location) — grant Niagara the Breezy Weather read permission from Niagara's app info → Permissions.

patches.name: Fix home screen numbers tile
patches.description: Hides the Channels diagnostic tip that shows up as a tile of giant numbers.

patches.name: Remove analytics
patches.description: Stops usage reports, retention events and analytics sessions.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Pro features and skips the trial prompt. Account sync and Stripe checkout still need a real purchase.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium features and stops the 10-hour trial countdown.

patches.name: Firefox Nightly app name
patches.description: Renames the app to Firefox Nightly, or to a name of your own.

patches.name: Firefox Nightly icon
patches.description: Swaps the launcher icon for the Nightly one.

patches.name: Firefox Nightly in-app logo
patches.description: Swaps the logo and wordmark shown inside the app.
